# Feature and platform availability

**Baseline: 2026-11-16.** This is a published-API inventory, not a certificate of independent native test coverage on every OS. See [limitations](limitations.md).

## Available runtimes

| Entry point | Linux | Windows | Runtime |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python SDK | Released wheel: glibc 2.39+; KDE Wayland targeted | Released Windows x64 wheel | Python 3.10+ |
| PowerShell SDK | PowerShell 7.2+; KDE Wayland targeted | PowerShell 7.2+ and Windows PowerShell 5.1 | Both editions on Windows |
| Native CLI | Linux x64 GitHub release | Windows x64 GitHub release | Standalone binary |
| Python UI | PyPI 0.1.1 (early release); same platform floor as the Python SDK | PyPI 0.1.1 (early release) | Python 3.10+ |
| PowerShell UI | PowerShell Gallery 0.1.1 (early release); PowerShell 7.2+ | PowerShell Gallery 0.1.1 (early release); PowerShell 7.2+ and 5.1 | Separate UI module |

## Feature exposure

| Capability | Python SDK | PowerShell SDK | CLI | Python UI | PowerShell UI | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Native windows | Released | Released | Released | Preview | Preview | Core host owns physical windows; CLI windows belong to commands. |
| Document text/attributes | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | SDK document operations; UI does not duplicate Core API. |
| Document input/events | Released | Released | Released | Preview | Preview | CLI handles select/form interaction, not general event subscription. |
| HTML forms/selection | Released | Released | Released | Preview | Preview | SDK form API and CLI form; UI has labeled input/select. |
| Native file/folder dialogs | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | Invoke from public language SDK, not a UI component. |
| HTML dialog and popover | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | UI library has no modal abstraction. |
| Multiple windows | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | UI examples mount a window; additional windows use SDK. |
| Clipboard and desktop services | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | OS services are exposed through SDKs. |
| Live bitmap RGBA8 | Released | Released | — | Via SDK | Via SDK | Public bounded bitmap APIs, not video playback. |
| Reactive state/computed | — | — | — | Preview | Preview | Python computed-state concurrency issue; see limitations. |
| Layout and compact components | — | — | — | Preview | Preview | A deliberate small UI library, not a full browser widget set. |
| Diagnostics and doctor | Released | Released | Released | Preview | Preview | Different scope/format across products. |
| Audio/video media player | — | — | — | — | — | Not implemented in current library scope. |

## Reading this table

- **Released** — Implemented in an announced release (independent native qualification still varies).
- **Preview** — Available as prerelease/preview; extra qualification required.
- **Via SDK** — Available via the owning language SDK, not a UI component.
- **—** — Not part of this entrypoint.
